links.outcome: CT referral test justification accuracy of LLMs vs independent experts vs ESR iGuide reference
links.effect: Independent experts achieved highest accuracy (92.4%) for medical test justification, surpassing GPT-4 (88.8%) and Claude-3 Haiku (85.2%).
links.quote: Independent experts achieved the highest accuracy (92.4%) for medical test justification, surpassing GPT-4 (88.8%) and Claude-3 Haiku (85.2%).

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the performance of LLMs (GPT-4 and Claude-3 Haiku) against human experts and a clinical decision support system (ESR iGuide) for justifying CT referrals.
